headline: EMBARGOED: Valcourt Group Q3 revenue down 4% organically, Asia weak

content.text:
EMBARGOED UNTIL 23 OCT 2026 06:00 CET. Valcourt Group reported third-quarter revenue of 2.31 billion euros, down 4 percent on an organic basis, as weakness in mainland China and Hong Kong offset growth in Europe and the Middle East.

Leather goods fell 6 percent while ready-to-wear and outerwear rose 2 percent, helped by an early cold spell in northern Europe in October. Japan slowed sharply after strong tourist spending in the first half.

The group kept its full-year margin guidance.
